**Localisation :** Canada et États\-Unis (formule hybride)
  
  

**Ta mission au sein de l’équipe mobile :**  

* Donner vie à la prochaine génération de notre application mobile en concevant et en développant principalement des fonctionnalités en React Native et TypeScript.
* Créer des expériences mobiles évolutives, performantes et faciles à maintenir pour iOS et Android.
* Contribuer à l’intégration progressive de modules React Native dans notre base de code iOS et Android native existante et participer à la définition des meilleures pratiques pour une architecture brownfield réussie.
* Collaborer étroitement avec les développeur·euse·s iOS afin d’assurer une cohabitation harmonieuse et efficace entre les composants React Native et Swift.
* Développer des modules natifs ou contribuer à leur développement lorsque certaines fonctionnalités nécessitent une intégration plus poussée avec iOS ou Android.
* Participer aux décisions d’architecture, notamment en évaluant si une fonctionnalité doit être développée en React Native ou nativement.
* Rester à l’affût des nouveaux frameworks, outils et pratiques de l’écosystème React Native, tout en maintenant une solide compréhension du développement mobile natif.
* Améliorer la performance, la stabilité, l’accessibilité et la testabilité de l’application, ainsi que l’expérience des développeur·euse·s.
* Effectuer des révisions de code approfondies en TypeScript et, lorsque pertinent, en Swift, tout en favorisant le partage des connaissances au sein de l’équipe.
* Collaborer avec les équipes Produit, Design, Assurance qualité, Backend et Développement mobile natif afin de définir, développer, tester et déployer de nouvelles fonctionnalités.
* Contribuer aux pratiques d’ingénierie de l’équipe, notamment les tests automatisés, l’intégration et le déploiement continus, la documentation, la gestion des mises en production et la surveillance des applications.
* Accompagner les autres développeur·euse·s et contribuer à la planification technique, aux discussions d’architecture et aux activités de recrutement, selon le niveau d’expérience.
* Promouvoir l’adoption responsable des outils de développement assistés par l’intelligence artificielle pour la génération et la révision de code, les tests, la documentation, le débogage et la refactorisation.


**Ton profil :**  

* Solide expérience professionnelle en développement et en mise en production d’applications mobiles, incluant une expérience pratique significative avec React Native.
* Maîtrise avancée de TypeScript, JavaScript, React et de l’écosystème React Native.
* Expérience avec des applications destinées au grand public et publiées sur l’App Store d’Apple et Google Play.
* Solide compréhension de l’architecture React Native, notamment du bridge, de JSI, des modules natifs et des principes de la nouvelle architecture.
* Expérience avec des outils comme Metro, Hermes, CocoaPods, Swift Package Manager, Gradle ainsi qu’avec les outils courants de débogage et d’optimisation des performances de React Native.
* Expérience dans l’intégration de fonctionnalités React Native à une application native existante ou dans un environnement mobile hybride.
* Expérience dans la création, la modification ou l’intégration de modules natifs en Swift, Objective\-C, Kotlin ou Java.
* Bonne connaissance du développement iOS natif. Une expérience avec Swift, SwiftUI ou UIKit constitue un atout important.
* Compréhension des enjeux de performance mobile, notamment le rendu, la gestion de la mémoire, le temps de démarrage de l’application, la gestion de l’état et la communication entre JavaScript et le code natif.
* Familiarité avec les architectures à flux de données unidirectionnel et les approches modernes de gestion de l’état.
* Capacité à participer à des discussions sur la conception logicielle, l’architecture, les patrons de conception et les compromis techniques dans des environnements natifs et multiplateformes.
* Solide compréhension des principes nécessaires pour produire un code clair, cohérent, testable, performant et facile à maintenir.
* Expérience avec les tests unitaires, les tests d’intégration et les tests automatisés pour les applications mobiles.
* Capacité démontrée à collaborer efficacement avec les équipes Produit, Design, Assurance qualité, Backend et Développement mobile afin de définir et de livrer de nouvelles fonctionnalités.

jobs.title: Frontend Developer
jobs.description:
At Web Hosting Canada (WHC), we’re passionate about helping Canadians succeed online with reliable, locally focused web hosting services. Since 2003, we’ve empowered businesses and individuals with top\-notch websites, domains, and email solutions.

  

If you’re looking for a dynamic, caring environment and you’re excited by the idea of building the interfaces thousands of Canadians rely on to manage their websites, domains, and email, we’d love to have you join our team.

 **The Opportunity**


Reporting to a Software Development Lead, you’ll build the interfaces our customers use to manage their websites, domains, and email, working in a squad with back\-end developers and designers. This role has two sides. The first is our modern platform: a React front\-end built in 2026 (React 19, Vite, Tailwind, TanStack Query, React Hook Form) where nearly all new feature work lands. It’s bilingual and accessible by default, built on our own components rather than a library, and developed with AI assistance as a normal part of the job.


The second is everything that came before: a large, working platform still running on jQuery, Bootstrap, and PHP\-rendered pages that isn’t disappearing anytime soon. Our React app mounts inside those older pages, so both worlds are often live on the same screen, and getting that right takes real hands\-on judgment. Pure greenfield React will frustrate you here; if you enjoy making old and new coexist properly, this is an unusually interesting job.

**What You’ll Do**

* Build features on our React platform: responsive, bilingual, accessible, tested.
* Maintain and extend the existing jQuery and PHP\-templated interfaces, including where our React app is embedded inside them.
* Turn designs into working interfaces, and tell us when a design won’t survive contact with real data or a second language.
* Build reusable components, since we maintain our own rather than depending on a library.
* Consume our internal APIs, and push back when a response shape makes the front end harder than it needs to be.
* Test and troubleshoot across browsers, screen sizes, and both of our host applications.
* Use AI tooling as part of your normal workflow, and help us get better at using it well.

**What You Bring**

* Several years building production front ends, with real depth in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS; we care more about range and judgment than an exact number of years.
* Modern component\-framework experience, ideally React. Strong Vue, Angular, or Svelte developers ready to switch are welcome; we’d rather that than someone who’s only followed React tutorials.
* Genuine comfort with the older stack, jQuery, direct DOM work, Bootstrap\-era CSS, server\-rendered templates; not nostalgia, it’s a large share of the work.
* Enough PHP to be useful, or the willingness to get there quickly; you won’t write our back end, but you’ll read PHP templates to find where your interface renders.
* CSS you can actually reason about: specificity, cascade, layout, and what happens when two eras of stylesheet collide.
* Accessibility as a habit, not a checklist; since we build our own components, nobody hands us correct keyboard behaviour and ARIA wiring for free.
* Working knowledge of building for two languages. Our interfaces ship in English and French together; a string that only exists in one is a bug, not a follow\-up ticket.
* Git, and comfort on a Linux command line.
* WordPress or a comparable CMS, ideally with custom plugin or theme work.
* An understanding of how web hosting and domain names work: the one thing we can’t teach quickly, and what separates a good front\-end developer from a good front\-end developer here.
* Deliberate use of AI in your work; we want to hear where it has genuinely made you faster and where it has burned you.
* Autonomy and reliability, with real care about what the end user experiences.
* Fluency in both English and French, written and spoken, to work with our Quebec\-based team, customers, and international partners.
* Must pass a security background check.

**Nice to Have**

* An eye for visual design and comfort working from design files.
* SEO fundamentals.
* Experience with a component or design system.
* Testing experience (we use Vitest and React Testing Library).

**Why Join WHC?**

* A collaborative team culture where your work is visible, your decisions matter, and your impact is meaningful.
* A Canadian, independent company with a clear market identity, a loyal customer base, and a strong focus on helping Canadians succeed online.
* An AI\-forward environment where we’re actively exploring how AI can improve how we build, operate, and support customers.
* Competitive compensation and benefits with a flexible hybrid work model.
* Access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities.
* Frequent gatherings, lively 5à7s, a vibrant social club, and memorable holiday parties.
* A bright, renovated office in Little Italy with a fully stocked kitchen and a game room featuring ping\-pong, foosball, Nintendo, Nerf guns, and a library.
* Certified a Great Place to Work® for five years running, because we believe work should be fun, fulfilling, and rewarding.

**Ready to Make an Impact?**


If you’re a front\-end developer who’s comfortable moving between a modern React platform and the legacy stack that still runs the business, and who genuinely cares about what the end user experiences, we want to hear from you.


Apply today and help us build the interfaces that keep WHC’s platform accessible, reliable, and easy to use for thousands of Canadians.

*WHC is an equal\-opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates, including those with diverse backgrounds and abilities.*

jobs.title: Développeur(euse) Frontend
jobs.description:
Chez Web Hosting Canada (WHC), nous sommes passionnés par le fait d’aider les Canadiens à réussir en ligne grâce à des services d’hébergement web fiables et axés sur le marché local. Depuis 2003, nous aidons les entreprises et les particuliers à réussir grâce à des solutions de qualité en matière de sites web, de domaines et de courriel.

  

Si vous cherchez un environnement dynamique et humain, et que l’idée de construire les interfaces sur lesquelles des milliers de Canadiens comptent pour gérer leurs sites Web, leurs noms de domaine et leur courriel vous enthousiasme, nous serions ravis de vous compter parmi nous.

 **L’occasion**


Relevant d’un chef d’équipe de développement logiciel, vous construirez les interfaces que nos clients utilisent pour gérer leurs sites Web, leurs noms de domaine et leur courriel, au sein d’une équipe qui réunit des développeurs back\-end et des designers. Ce poste a deux facettes. La première, c’est notre plateforme moderne : une plateforme front\-end en React bâtie en 2026 (React 19, Vite, Tailwind, TanStack Query, React Hook Form) où se fait pratiquement tout le nouveau développement. Elle est bilingue et accessible par défaut, construite sur nos propres composants plutôt que sur une bibliothèque externe, et développée avec l’assistance de l’IA comme partie normale du travail.


La seconde, c’est tout ce qui existait avant : une grande plateforme bien vivante qui roule toujours sur jQuery, Bootstrap et des pages générées en PHP, et qui ne disparaîtra pas de si tôt. Notre application React s’intègre à l’intérieur de ces pages plus anciennes, ce qui veut dire que les deux univers cohabitent souvent dans le même écran, et bien faire les choses demande un vrai jugement technique. Si vous ne voulez que du React en terrain neuf, ce poste vous frustrera. Si vous aimez faire cohabiter l’ancien et le nouveau comme il faut, c’est un travail particulièrement intéressant.

**Ce que vous ferez**

* Développer des fonctionnalités sur notre plateforme React : adaptatives, bilingues, accessibles, testées.
* Entretenir et faire évoluer les interfaces existantes en jQuery et en gabarits PHP, y compris aux endroits où notre application React s’y intègre.
* Transformer les maquettes en interfaces fonctionnelles, et nous dire quand une maquette ne survivra pas au contact de données réelles ou d’une deuxième langue.
* Créer des composants réutilisables, puisque nous maintenons les nôtres plutôt que de dépendre d’une bibliothèque.
* Consommer nos API internes, et nous le signaler lorsqu’une réponse mal structurée complique inutilement le travail côté front\-end.
* Tester et déboguer sur différents navigateurs, différentes tailles d’écran et nos deux applications hôtes.
* Intégrer les outils d’IA à votre travail quotidien, et nous aider à mieux les utiliser collectivement.

**Ce que vous apportez**

* Plusieurs années d’expérience en développement front\-end en production, avec une réelle profondeur en JavaScript, HTML et CSS; l’étendue et le jugement comptent plus qu’un nombre précis d’années.
* De l’expérience avec un cadriciel à composants moderne, idéalement React. Une personne solide en Vue, Angular ou Svelte prête à passer à React est bienvenue; nous préférons cela à quelqu’un qui n’a suivi que des tutoriels React.
* Une aisance véritable avec la pile technologique plus ancienne, jQuery, manipulation directe du DOM, CSS de l’époque Bootstrap, gabarits générés côté serveur; ce n’est pas de la nostalgie, c’est une part importante du travail.
* Assez de PHP pour être utile, ou la volonté d’y arriver rapidement; vous n’écrirez pas notre back\-end, mais vous lirez des gabarits PHP pour trouver où votre interface est générée.
* Un CSS que vous comprenez réellement : spécificité, cascade, mise en page, et ce qui arrive quand deux époques de feuilles de style se heurtent.
* L’accessibilité comme réflexe, pas comme case à cocher; comme nous créons nos propres composants, personne ne nous fournit gratuitement la navigation au clavier et le câblage ARIA corrects.
* Une bonne connaissance du développement bilingue. Nos interfaces sont livrées en français et en anglais ensemble; une chaîne de caractères qui n’existe que dans une seule langue est un bogue, pas un billet de suivi.
* Git, et de l’aisance en ligne de commande sous Linux.
* WordPress ou un système de gestion de contenu comparable, idéalement avec du développement d’extensions ou de thèmes sur mesure.
* Une compréhension du fonctionnement de l’hébergement Web et des noms de domaine : la seule chose que nous ne pouvons pas enseigner rapidement, et ce qui distingue une bonne personne en développement front\-end d’une bonne personne en développement front\-end chez nous.
* Une utilisation réfléchie de l’IA dans votre travail; nous voulons savoir où elle vous a réellement fait gagner du temps, et où elle vous a joué des tours.
* Autonomie et fiabilité, avec un souci réel de l’expérience vécue par la personne utilisatrice.
* Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral et à l’écrit, pour travailler avec notre équipe basée au Québec, notre clientèle et nos partenaires internationaux.
* Réussite d’une vérification des antécédents en matière de sécurité.

**Atouts**

* Un sens du design visuel et de l’aisance à travailler à partir de fichiers de conception.
* Les principes de base du référencement (SEO).
* De l’expérience avec un système de composants ou de design.
* De l’expérience en tests (nous utilisons Vitest et React Testing Library).

**Pourquoi vous joindre à WHC?**

* Une culture d’équipe collaborative où votre travail est visible, où vos décisions comptent et où votre impact est significatif.
* Une entreprise canadienne et indépendante, dotée d’une identité de marché claire, d’une clientèle fidèle et d’une réelle volonté d’aider les Canadiens à réussir en ligne.
* Un environnement tourné vers l’IA, où nous explorons activement comment l’IA peut améliorer notre façon de bâtir, d’exploiter et de soutenir nos clients.
*

### **About Behavox**



Behavox is a cloud\-native AI company providing an integrated controls platform for global banks, asset managers, hedge funds, private equity firms, insurance businesses, and commodity firms. The platform unifies communications and trade surveillance, compliant archiving, policy management as well as front\-office analytics on a single, AI\-native technology stack, delivered as a globally scalable SaaS\-based cloud service.



At Behavox, our engineering culture is built around speed, experimentation, and technical excellence, following agile principles and rapid iteration. We constantly test and adopt the latest cloud technologies and AI tooling, optimising for fast feedback loops and execution. We look for people who can move fast, challenge conventional wisdom, and who want to work at the frontier of modern AI, SaaS platforms, and distributed systems.



Behavox is a high\-performance organisation with a strong bias toward delivery, ownership, and responsibility. We commit, and we execute. We are building systems that are complex, mission\-critical, and global in scale; systems that many consider too large or too difficult. To do that, we seek the smartest, most technically capable engineers and technologists who take end\-to\-end responsibility and want to win by building what others cannot.



Founded in 2014 and backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Behavox is headquartered in London, with offices worldwide, including New York City, Montreal, Seattle, Singapore, and Tokyo.


### **About the Role**



The Senior FP\&A Analyst owns Behavox's core financial model — its architecture, the accounting beneath it, and the forecasts and analysis the company plans and decides by. The role exists to change decisions, not report them: it turns the numbers into the choices leadership actually faces. It reads and integrates budgets into the model, but does not run the budgeting cycle.



The same analyst builds the valuations, scenarios, and pro\-forma models behind every acquisition — evaluating targets, running diligence, and folding closed deals into a single consolidated view. This work is periodic and must be carried alone when it arrives; the steady state is the operating model and SaaS forecasting.



This is a high\-autonomy role that works without a detailed brief and sets the modeling standard others build on. It is accountable for the accuracy and integrity of the numbers, and for turning them into recommendations sharp enough to act on — the downside case included, not just the point estimate — for senior leadership, the board, and investors. It pressure\-tests the assumptions behind every result, works fluently with modern tooling and AI, and compounds that edge by learning relentlessly. Its influence comes from the rigor and reach of the analysis, not from authority: it owns the model and the truth it tells, not the decisions made from it.


### **What You'll Bring**


* **Financial Model \& Accounting Foundations** — Knows how an integrated three\-statement and operating model fits together, and the accounting that holds it up — SaaS revenue recognition and cost treatment included. Understands exactly how the company's budgets are built, and folds them into the model.


* **Forecasting \& SaaS Unit Economics** — Knows both bottom\-up short\-term forecasting and driver\-based long\-term modeling, and the SaaS metrics that actually reveal performance. Knows what moves each one and which lever changes it — not just how to report it.


* **Mergers, Acquisitions \& Integration** — Knows how to value an acquisition and how to fold it into one consolidated model: purchase accounting, combined\-entity projections, and the mechanics that make or break the integration.


* **Business \& Commercial Acumen** — Knows in depth how the business and every function make money — the revenue drivers, the cost structure, the operating levers — and spots a number that doesn't add up on sight.


* **Financial Systems \& AI Tooling** — Commands Google Sheets and Excel, and tracks the AI and automation landscape closely enough to know where it is trustworthy and where it isn't.


### **What You'll Do**


* **Financial Model Ownership** — Builds and maintains the core three\-statement and operating model with scenario and sensitivity layers, and keeps it accurate, clean, and easy to maintain. Integrates budgets without owning the cycle, and owns the accuracy of every output and the integrity of every assumption.


* **Acquisition Modeling \& Integration** — Builds the valuations, scenarios, and pro\-forma combined\-entity models behind acquisition evaluation and due diligence, and folds closed deals into a single consolidated view.


* **Business\-Review Reporting** — Drives much of the substance of the monthly, quarterly, and annual business reviews — with the broader FP\&A team — for senior management, the board, and investors, turning the model into a narrative that explains what moved the results and what it means for the business.


* **Metrics Analysis \& Business Partnering** — Diagnoses why the metrics are moving and which lever changes them, pressure\-tests the assumptions behind every result, and hands the decision\-maker a recommendation they can act on.


* **AI\-Enabled Productivity** — Uses AI and spreadsheet automation to compress cycle time and harden data validation — automating the recurring work while keeping judgment on what stays manual.

jobs.description:
#### **Role**


The Technical Support Specialist provides second\-level technical assistance nationally, supporting client, company, and end users at the desktop, laptop, printer, network, operating system, point of sale, and infrastructure level. The role covers hardware, software, and software deployment support, remote troubleshooting, and remote escalated support for Field Service Technicians.


Specialists act as a technical resource for resolving complex issues, and advise, install, train, and assist the end\-user community. This second\-level support role is structured in two levels: Level 1 (base) and Level 2 (Intermediate), with Level 2 taking on independent resolution of complex issues, root cause analysis, and mentoring.

#### **Level 1 – Technical Support Specialist**

**Responsibilities and Duties**

* Provide responsive, timely remote support to escalated end\-user questions and support requests from Field Service Technicians nationally.
* Act as point of contact for desktop and laptop support and troubleshooting for clients, company, and end users, performing problem determination and resolution of hardware and software issues.
* Troubleshoot computer systems, including hardware, software, email, operating system, network, and peripheral issues; make repairs and corrections where required.
* Remotely assist onsite technicians with the installation and assembly of hardware where required, and configure computers, monitors, network infrastructure, and peripherals such as printers, scanners, POS, and related hardware.
* Install, configure, and upgrade operating systems and standard business software, including remotely supporting imaging and software deployment following established procedures.
* Remotely direct onsite technicians on cabling and rewiring as required for new installations and office reconfigurations.
* Validate that systems work as expected before handing them back to users.
* Ensure all incidents are properly logged, triaged, routed, escalated, and closed in accordance with pre\-determined service levels and incident management processes.
* Ensure client technology requirements and the set\-up and configuration of desktop hardware, software, and local and network printers are accurately determined, documented, and satisfied.
* Document configurations, technical issues, and resolutions accurately and completely, and maintain accurate asset and configuration records.
* Assist with training staff on standard business and administrative software (word processing, spreadsheets, database management), providing instruction or written documentation where required.
* Escalate outstanding and unresolved issues to the Senior Manager, Technical Services and Senior Director, Professional Services within the time requirements set out in service contracts.
* Follow established security policies, change management processes, and industry best practices.
* Maintain current knowledge of the hardware and software technologies in use by client, company, and end users to provide technically accurate solutions.

#### **Level 2 – Technical Support Specialist (Intermediate)**


In addition to all Level 1 responsibilities, Level 2 requires:

**Responsibilities and Duties**

* Independently troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware and operating system issues with minimal supervision.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring incidents and recommend permanent corrective actions.
* Remotely support and train Level 1 specialists and Field Service Technicians nationally through technical guidance and knowledge sharing.
* Participate in infrastructure upgrade and migration projects as required.
* Maintain technical documentation, support standards, and operational procedures.

#### **Requirements**

**Level 1**

* College diploma or university degree in Computer Science, Computer Studies, Information Technology, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 2–3 years of related technical support experience.
* Working and advanced knowledge of IT hardware and equipment installation, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and support.
* Strong customer service orientation, interpersonal skills, and verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Detail oriented, with strong organizational and documentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team while meeting service level agreements (SLAs).
* CompTIA A\+ is a strong asset; Microsoft Certified credentials are an asset.

**Level 2 (in addition to Level 1\)**

* 4–5\+ years of progressive IT infrastructure or systems administration experience.
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, VLANs, VPNs, DNS, routing, switching).
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity best practices and endpoint security.
* Microsoft Certified, CompTIA Linux\+, LPIC, Red Hat, VMware Certified Professional (VCP), or equivalent certifications are highly desirable.

#### **Working Conditions**

* This is a hybrid position, working from a BFG office and from home.
* Must be able and willing to work rotating shifts, including nights for extended periods, evenings, weekends, and holidays, to support a 24/7 client service environment.
* Must have a valid driver’s license and access to a vehicle; public transit is not reliable during night shift rotations.

**Job Summary**
---------------


The Canadian Security Intelligence Service (CSIS) is looking for dedicated individuals to fill the position of Communications Analyst in its various regional offices across Canada. Candidates must possess a high level of initiative, motivation and discretion.


This position will be of interest to individuals who are able to translate from one or more foreign languages identified below into French or English and who are able to work effectively as part of a team. As a Communications Analyst, you will read or listen to foreign language material, determine its relevance and importance as well as produce translations and draft reports based on the intelligence value in the material, to generate leads for investigations.


Under the direction of a Team Leader, you will be responsible for assessing, identifying oral and written communications, collaborate with counterparts and stakeholders, and provide advice to management. This requires the ability to conduct extensive research and analysis on various subjects (social, economic, geopolitical and ethno\-cultural), and be able to draw on your understanding of the culture concerned. As such, a keen interest in intelligence and politics is a must. Furthermore, the incumbent must be at ease working with computer systems and using social media.


CSIS is looking for individuals with the following language proficiency:


* Mandarin
* Russian
* Punjabi
* Urdu
* Hindi
* Spanish
